title: Grimoire Archive: Core Loop
summary: Unlock, read, cross-reference, and return to play with clearer arcane context.

blocks.title: Unlock
blocks.body: Gain archive access through route progress, scans, provider data, or bridge records.

blocks.title: Read
blocks.body: Read the warning, field note, or forbidden context before treating the entry as flavor text.

blocks.title: Return
blocks.body: Use related Index pages or mission context to turn the archive into one next action.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
